## ✅ Checklist for Review

- [ ] All TOML files in `versions/<version>/` are valid.
- [ ] `packwiz refresh` has been executed for the target version.
- [ ] Hashes in `index.toml` and `pack.toml` match and have been verified via `python3 -m unittest discover tests`.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has been updated under `[Unreleased]` or a new version section following Keep a Changelog.
